lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: Prepare an open NGW vector layer where one pull creates and deletes at least 1000 features while the map is visible; include one server feature with missing or invalid geometry and an existing local copy of that remote ID
Start manual sync once and interact with the map while that layer is applied
Reopen the project, run a no-change sync and export HyperLog
value.expected: The process remains alive and responsive; incremental pull emits no per-row vector cache notification storm, performs one final spatial cache rebuild and one layer reload; the invalid server geometry is skipped, its previous local row is retained, and the rest of the layer commits; no notify_insert/GeoEnvelope/GeometryRTree crash, LinkedTreeMap style exception or spatial cache count mismatch appears on reopen, and the no-change sync leaves cache and SQLite counts equal.
